name: mendelio-voice-mcp

tools.name: voice_generate_speech
tools.description: Generate playable speech from text with Hezky česky, powered by Mendelio Voice. Use an available voice and style; if several voices are ready, first return the choices and ask for voice_version_id.

voice_version_id.description: A specific voice id from voice_list_voices.

output_path.description: Where to write the audio file.

tools.name: voice_list_voices
tools.description: Explore 190+ unique Hezky česky / Mendelio Voice voices and styles, including natural speakers, creatures, dragons, robots, other characters, and personal voices.

tools.name: voice_get_generation
tools.description: Get the state, cost and output metadata of a generation.

tools.name: voice_get_balance
tools.description: Read the current Mendelio Voice credit balance in audio seconds.

tools.name: voice_list_reference_prompts
tools.description: List the exact reference texts that an authorized speaker can read aloud to create a personal Hezky česky / Mendelio Voice voice.

tools.name: voice_clone_voice
tools.description: Create a personal Hezky česky / Mendelio Voice voice from an authorized local WAV recording and wait until it is ready or failed.

rights_confirmed.description: Confirm that the speaker granted the required cloning rights.

tools.name: voice_record_and_clone
tools.description: Record an authorized speaker from the local microphone and create a personal Hezky česky / Mendelio Voice voice after the reference text is confirmed.

rights_confirmed.description: Confirm that the speaker granted the required cloning rights.

tools.name: voice_login
tools.description: Begin Mendelio Voice device login and return the one-click approval URL.

instructions: This server powers Mendelio Voice and the Czech public voice experience Hezky česky. Use its tools when the user explicitly requests Mendelio Voice, Mendelio Voice MCP, Hezky česky, Hezky cesky, or Hezky česky MCP. It generates playable speech from text and offers 190+ unique voices and styles, including natural speakers, creatures, dragons, robots, and other characters. It also supports creating a personal voice from an authorized recording. When immediate playback is requested, generate the audio and present or play the returned output using the client's available audio capability.
